title: The 4th Annual Parliament vs. Diplomats Golf Tournament
summary: The Anglo-Asia Education Foundation was delighted to sponsor the 4th annual Parliament vs. Diplomats Golf Tournament on Friday, 18 July...
body:
The Anglo-Asia Education Foundation was delighted to sponsor the 4th annual Parliament vs. Diplomats Golf Tournament on Friday, 18 July, hosted by the Parliamentary Golf Society at Wentworth Golf Club’s Edinburgh Course. From the first tee to the last putt in the early evening, it was a warm, good-natured day that paired excellent golf with even better conversation.


Beyond the fairways, the tournament offered space for insightful discussion and new connections. We extend our sincere thanks to Lord McNicol of West Kilbride for his collaboration and support, and to the Parliamentary Golf Society for helping with the organisation. We are grateful to the many participating diplomats — including representatives from the South African Embassy. We look forward to building on this year’s success and to welcoming familiar — and new — faces at next year’s tournament.

Until then, thank you to everyone who joined us at Wentworth for a truly memorable day.
